Method.Description: Formulation: 'ELD' (economic load dispatch, branches ignored), 'DC OPF' (DC approximation) or 'AC OPF' (AC power flow equations)

Solver.Description: Optimization solver ('auto': the solver that 'solve' chooses for the problem)

Verbose.Description: Print the progress of the solver (Display 'iter'; false: 'none')

Progress.Description: Progress display during the calculation (the solver and its iterations): 'dialog' (opens when the calculation lasts 0.5 s or longer), 'disp' (one line per step in the Command Window) or 'none'

MaxIteration.Description: 'MaxIterations' option of the solver (NaN: the default of the solver)

Tolerance.Description: 'OptimalityTolerance' option of the solver (NaN: the default of the solver)

WarmStart.Description: Start 'AC OPF' from the last AC OPF solution of the network (false: flat start)

PlotFcn.Description: Live display during the analysis (fmincon only, 'AC OPF'): the plot function optimplot<key> of fmincon, or 'none'. The figure after the analysis: result.plot_dispatch()

MinDampingRatio.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': lower limit of the damping ratio of the oscillatory modes of get_sys at the solution (NaN: no limit)

MaxRealPart.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': upper limit [1/s] of the real part of the nonzero eigenvalues of get_sys at the solution (NaN: no limit)

StabilityMaxIteration.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': largest number of outer iterations (OPF with linearized stability constraints)

StabilityStep.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': initial trust region [dP dV] [pu] of each outer iteration (Inf: none for that kind)

StabilityMargin.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': margin [damping ratio, real part 1/s] of the linearized constraints over the limits

StabilityBand.Description: Stability-constrained 'AC OPF': width [damping ratio, real part 1/s] of the band near a limit whose modes get linearized constraints
